you_should_know.title: Lyons could become first Colorado town to require wildfire mitigation at existing homes
you_should_know.summary: In an effort to bolster wildfire defenses, the Town of Lyons, a small town about 15 miles north of Boulder, is eyeing an unprecedented ordinance requiring homeowners to implement specific mitigation measures.
